name: SVG Optimizer with Visual Diff

seo.title: SVG Optimizer with Visual Diff — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Sanitize and reduce SVG markup, then raster-compare before/after output to highlight visible differences.

assumptions: Optimization is conservative and prioritizes preserving rendering over maximum byte reduction.
limitations: The visual diff is raster-based at selected dimensions and may not expose every semantic/accessibility change.
